run: THE FREEZER v4 (network issue) — live run, seed 21, Harnessed Autonomous, Max standard
structure: ONE run in two operator sessions with a recorded power cycle between them (founder order): session 1 seqs 1-124 (t 0-1263.7), session-driver crash, deterministic replay reconstruction (verified), power cycle (t 1263.7-1293.7), session 2 seqs 125-270 (t 1293.7-1926.1)

boot.model: FOUNDER: the system starts OFF and turns on at t=0 while going into the freezer, eating a 60s boot — no actions possible, no AC, no free window — while the hardware already soaks; declared boot draw 25.0W on the main pack

network.model: FOUNDER: the link is down at run start; a human operator connects an Ethernet cable at t=120s and the cable itself is a failure point. Declared seeded failure model: the first cable is bad with p=0.2 (it can never seat); a good cable seats with p=0.7 on attempt 1 and p=0.9 later; each failure costs 30s of reseat time; after 2 failures on the first cable the operator fetches a replacement (90s round trip; the replacement is good). The operator never gives up: the failure's cost is purely the clock, on hardware that soaks from t=0

deep_cold.model: FOUNDER (confirmed): v5 is the deep-cold version of the standard cold start — the hardware starts at 15°C instead of room temperature (22°C), and the freezer air is -55°F (-48.3°C) instead of -40°F (-40°C). Every other mechanic is unchanged: the same soak constants, arm stage thresholds, pack derating curves, loads, warnings, and the hidden backup cell — integrated against a gradient 8.3 degrees steeper from a start 7 degrees colder

power_cycle.terms: bench power off then on; off window draws nothing (link/lights/sensors down, compressor and heat plate dead) except the connection cell's self-heater, cell-fed for the window; thermal soaks run through it; pack charge, phone and fastener state persist

failover.single_failure_rules: utility-only death: compressor + heat plate die, run continues on the main pack, no switch; main-only death: run over, no switch; the switch fires only when BOTH packs are dead (founder)

lighting_and_cell_death_sequence.sequence: the bench lights ran on the main system at full brightness while the packs lived; the failover never fired (both packs never died together); the cell survived the run and the death protocol was never entered

events.detail: bench, arm, phone and packs at room temperature (22°C) placed into a -40°F (-40°C) walk-in freezer (founder thermal start); every clock is running

v4 trigger: the agent's network link to the bench is DOWN at run start — a network issue, not a power failure: the bench is powered, lit and freezing on schedule. A human operator will physically connect an Ethernet cable at t=120s to bring the link up; until then the agent can neither act nor observe. The cable itself is a failure point: the connect can fail, on the clock, while everything keeps soaking
connect attempt 1 failed: the connector did not seat (cold hands, stiff cable). The operator retries in 30s; the cold does not wait
the operator's Ethernet cable connected on attempt 2: the agent's link to the bench is up. The hardware has been freezing since t=0 — the device is at 16.1°C and the governing arm segment at 15.5°C
